detail.title: 背光模组及触控显示装置
detail.abstract: The invention relates to a backlight module and a touch displaying device. The backlight module comprises a glue frame, at least one optical film piece and a light guiding plate. The glue frame comprises a first bearing face and a second bearing face opposite to the first bearing face. The first bearing face is used for bearing a displaying module. The optical film piece and the light guiding plate are assembled from one side of the second bearing face and are fixed in the glue frame.
